initial.entityTitle: Northern depot accessibility refit and replacement display materials
initial.description: The northern depot is coordinating a multi-room accessibility refit with a receiving team that shares its loading bay with another institution. Preserve the full delivery note, including the instruction to call the facilities desk after arrival, leave the archival labels attached, and keep the last pallet upright while the rear lift is in use.

lots.label: Release northern lot
lots.detail: Very long conservation packaging instruction: this lot contains folded interpretive panels, replacement tactile labels, and a rigid display support that must remain flat until the destination crew has signed the receiving sheet.

lots.label: Release accessible fittings
lots.detail: A mixed lot of access rails and small fittings, each in a labeled reusable pouch. Do not separate the pouch list from its returnable crate.

lots.label: Release reserve stock
lots.detail: Reserve labels and mounting plates remain held while the receiving institution confirms whether its storage area is ready.
